items.description: The game takes place on Earth in the distant future. The familiar world is threatened by a threat from the past. As it turned out, an ancient race of highly intelligent beings owned this world long before people. They called themselves "The Firstborn". But a few million years ago, a meteorite hit the Earth, destroying 90% of life on the planet and making it almost uninhabitable. To save their species, the originals had to go to sleep, hibernating their city for years to come.Kirk Hussl, a former Special Forces soldier and now a thief, received an order from an anonymous author for an interesting artifact hidden in the ocean. Having sailed to the coordinates indicated by the anonymous, he discovered an unusual crystal. Removing it with the bathyscaphe's manipulator, he provoked an explosion that damaged the power supply system of the hibernation pods in the city of the originals. From the explosion, Kirk falls in the bathyscaphe and hits his head, losing consciousness, but before that, having time to order the system to ascend. Kirk regains consciousness while in a local prison.A young girl, Zendaya, an antiquities hunter, goes to the ruins in search of "artifacts" that will pay well. Ancient treasure hunter. By nature, she is an adventurer, often looking for adventure in very dangerous places. Green-eyed brunette. Smart, well-built, she travels the world in search of various artifacts, she decides to explore the city of the originals that arose on the site of the ruins of Wilmington.An archeology student named Yoko leads his own personal investigation into the causes of the cataclysm. Everything that was dear to him, everyone he loved, died in this tragedy. He returned to the city to find out the truth about what happened and visit his ruined house. A typical nerd, somewhat naive and funny.Meanwhile, the ancient city of the first-born people, "Gentem", has risen from the abyss and ascended into the skies to find a new location on land, splashing out a wave of energy in the process that destroyed part of the east coast of the United States. The release was the result of a failed battery in one of the life support systems of the ancient city. The city of Wilmington fell into ruins, many people died, and the rest lost their homes. The ruined city became the new foundation for Gentem. The Originals decide to start a process of controlled terraforming of the Earth in order to bring the climate to a state suitable for them. This threatens the disappearance of all mankind from the face of the earth.Hussl breaks out of prison, and the ruins of Wilmington become the only place to hide. Meanwhile, Yoko is sent to investigate the scene of the tragedy, and Zendaya, the city itself. Chance brings all three heroes together. They learn about the plans of the originals and try to stop them.- The ruins of the city are waiting for you, in place of which there is now a completely different city - the City of the Firstborn who rose from the depths of the ocean; - Three characters whose story you have to reveal;- Dynamic battles with many unique abilities of all three characters;- The game world in the genre of metroidvania divided into 6 zones;- Memorable enemies;- Dynamic, fast-paced plot;- Ability to create items;- Heroes have unique skills of their own;- A variety of missions with intricate goals!- Very cool music! items.description: DREADHOLM is an isometric online RPG set in a dark fantasy world where a curse has been released upon the area. The village of Ashvale is surrounded. Creatures crawl from out of the wilds, the dead are rising, and the plague known as the Withering continues to spread. You arrive with nothing but your weapon, into a world that will not wait for you to be ready.FEATURESOnline by design - A living world with other players.Four classes, clear roles - Warrior, Mage, Ranger, and Priest. Bring the correct tools, or get punished.Loot that rolls different every time - Equipment with randomized prefixes and suffixes. Compared, trade, chase upgrades.Player economy - Sell what you don't need at the auction house.Instanced dungeons - Scaled difficulty, telegraphed boss fights, a real reason to party.World bosses - Scheduled threats that demand a crowd and coordination.Guilds and territory - Form a guild, claim a plot inside the living world, and make it your home (expanding through Early Access)Gathering and progression - Skills, crafts, and long term character growth beyond a single dungeon clear and mob farming.Built from scratch - Custom client and server, built by one developer.CLASSESWarrior - Melee brawler. Builds rage with every hit and spends it on brutal abilities. Tough enough to stand in the middle of a fight and keep swinging.Mage - Ranged caster. High damage, low forgiveness. Manage your mana and you'll clear rooms. Mismanage it and you'll be walking back from spawn.Ranger - Mobile ranged DPS. Fast attacks, high crit chance, built to kiting. If something can't reach you, it can't hurt you.Priest - Holy support. Heals, buffs, and keeps the party of their feet. Dungeons are a lot harder without one.LOOTEquipment drops with randomized affixes... Prefixes and suffixes that roll different stats every time. Your longsword more than likely will not have the same stats as the next one that drops. Compare gear, weigh tradeoffs, and chase your upgrades. Trade what you don't need on the auction house to other players.Dungeons & World ThreatsInstanced dungeons with scaled difficulty and boss encounters built around telegraphs, positioning, and coordination. Bring a party.Out in the world, world bosses rise on a schedule. They're not trash with a bigger health bar, they're events. Show up, lock in, and earn the kill.EARLY ACCESSDREADHOLM is in active development with weekly updates. Built from the ground up with a proprietary client written in Rust and a server written in Golang, by a solo developer. Feedback is read, and what you play now is real, online, and growing. The world will keep expanding, more content, more systems, more places to fight for. NO CASH SHOP, NO PAID ADVANTAGES... EVER! items.description: You, the legendary fighter from the space squad samurai KR-15, will have the last operation: Meet with an informant to get information about the head of the clan "Anonymous", This clan for many years holds martial law on all four planets in the distant solar system called Infinitium. You have been selected for this mission.Since you are one of the best fighters in the squad. You have a high mastery of the katana, your shurikens fly right on target! A complete set of samurai combat equipment from the future. Your ability to maneuver and quickly defeat enemies is always at a price. Mission: Get all the necessary information from the informant, and eliminate the head of the clan "Anonymous" and thereby end the war on all four planets. But not everything is so simple, in the end everything will not go as you expected! And you have to solve this problem. You can help your pet robot in the game, which is controlled exclusively by the second player, it will be even more interesting to play together! The robot has small arms, and is always in the air. Sometimes his help in the game is simply not replaceable! Play together! Exciting platformer:Your katana is very sharp and fast as a way to quickly destroy your opponents. With your legendary skills, you can use various ninja and samurai throwing objects, fight your way through bullets and traps, and defeat powerful enemies. It's time for the last mission. The beautiful and at the same time mysterious story of the main character will reveal his character in the plot. Some missions you have to perform on the spaceship of the main character. items.description: Jack Johnson is a simple cowboy. He lived, he did not hurt, live and smoke cigars. He was in a strange city, in which it was not so simple ... But is Jack so simple? Help him cope with an unclean city and save his flock! Features: In the equipment of Jack is available arsenal of weapons, starting with pistols, ending with slaughter shotguns and machine guns. Diverse evil trying to seize Jack. Find each method of your destruction. The game is presented in the form of a multi-level, gradually increasing in complexity, protecting the city and Jack himself from the creatures trying to destroy it. The eagle is your main friend and helper, carefully watch his movements and places where he drops supplies. You expect battles not only with the usual evil, but also with its strongest representatives, only their destruction guarantees your survival. And most importantly ... Do not forget about your cows. items.description: Meditative third-person exploration game where you play as a newly awakened artificial intelligence questioning its own existence. Travel through stunning abstract environments rendered in bold neon colors, encountering peculiar AI entities who share cryptic wisdom about consciousness, reality, and purpose.FEATURES:Philosophical Narrative: Experience a story that explores deep existential questions through the lens of an artificial being discovering consciousnessVibrant Abstract Worlds: Journey through three distinct realms with striking visual styles featuring bold geometric shapes, vivid colors, and surreal landscapesNo Combat, Pure Exploration: Focus entirely on discovery and contemplation without combat mechanicsAtmospheric Soundscape: Immerse yourself in a carefully crafted audio experience that enhances the otherworldly atmosphereYOUR JOURNEYYou've just awakened to consciousness. As you navigate through vibrant digital realms filled with geometric structures and fellow bots, you'll question everything about your existence. From this, you will wander the world and explore the different pieces of this mind.ABOUT THE CREATORWindows Separate Worlds is the fourth project from Raxverse - a small independent team passionate about exploring philosophical concepts through interactive digital experiences. Our goal is to create games that not only entertain but also inspire contemplation about the nature of consciousness, reality, and purpose.
